sections.title: A Keysight MS3054A oscilloscope displaying a waveform.
sections.summary: An electrical signal analysis device, open and revealing its interface. The black screen displays a waveform with a green color, indicating a specific frequency or amplitude.

sections.title: An oscilloscope displaying two different signals with time on the horizontal axis and amplitude on the vertical.
sections.summary: The left side shows a yellow signal labeled 'V1' with varying peak-to-peak amplitudes over time, indicating it might be a voltage or another kind of signal with periodic peaks. The right side shows a green signal labeled 'V2', which appears to have a more regular pattern with less variation in amplitude over time.
